name: app-flow-ride-overview-and-active-tracking-screens-dark-green
title: Flow cycling app: ride overview and active-tracking screens in dark green with rationale notes
whatItIs: Two dark phone screens with glowing green accents: 'Sürüşün' (Your Ride) showing a route map, distance and start button, and an active-tracking screen with a circular progress ring, distance/time stats and a live road photo, each paired with a Turkish designer's-rationale caption and a dotted connector.
whatItMeans: Focused and considered; pairing each screen with the designer's own reasoning turns a UI shot into a mini case study.
techniques: Caption each screen with the design rationale behind it.
Use a dotted line to link a screen to its explanation.
Keep only essential data visible during active use.

vocabulary.definition: A circular stroke showing completion or a live metric.
The stated reasoning behind a design decision.
